root_cause_criterion.obligation: the bytes of buf consumed by the 11-byte strncmp must be initialized on every reaching path
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: initialize the compared range before the header probe or avoid the probe on short lines

nodes.description: the begin-line probe consumes 11 bytes while the initialized prefix reaching it is shorter, so strncmp reads uninitialized stack data

edges.description: the short initialized-prefix length from BIO_gets is carried forward to the strncmp probe after normalization, so the sink sees the same insufficient prefix length
